user.title: Welcome to AmperePoint
user.description: Choose a direct LAN connection or use entities from an existing integration. Detected entity sources: {count}. AmperePoint Local does not require the Tuya Local integration.

automatic.title: Choose your charger
automatic.description: Select the Tuya charger that TuyaExtend should normalize for Home Assistant.

settings.title: Finish setup
settings.description: Set the charging tariff and session-completion settings. A shared AmperePoint dashboard is created automatically.

manual.title: AmperePoint
manual.description: Select a charger model and map the available source entities. Fields for unavailable datapoints may be left empty.

prime_profile.title: Add Wallbox Prime profile (Tuya Local)
prime_profile.description: Add the Wallbox PRIME profile to Tuya Local. The profile reads data provided by the charger: power, session energy, temperature, phase measurements and vehicle connection. Data availability depends on compatible device DPs. Start/stop, current control and the planner are not yet supported. Tuya Local must be installed through HACS. An existing profile with different contents will be preserved.

local.title: AmperePoint Local
local.description: Direct LAN connection — no Tuya Local required. A recognized, verified PRIME variant gets a dashboard with controls and the HA planner. Other compatible variants provide readings only.

menu_options.local_import: Choose a charger from Tuya in HA
menu_options.local_manual: Enter device ID and local key

local_manual.title: AmperePoint Local
local_manual.description: Credentials are saved in HA configuration. Runtime reads work locally without a Tuya account in HA. Leave IP blank for discovery; Docker/VLAN networks may require a manual address.

local_import.title: Choose your charger
local_import.description: Copy the local key once from the already authorized HA Tuya integration. Subsequent reads use LAN only, with no cloud fallback.

local_confirm.title: LAN connection succeeded
local_confirm.description: {name} responds at {host}. PRIME LAN controls are supported. Confirm to create the full dashboard: start/stop, current limit, energy-target charging and weekly planner. Adding the charger does not change its physical state. Saved schedules remain disabled until you enable them. Modes and schedules run in HA, which must stay running and connected over LAN. Keep the charger app in immediate mode.

local_confirm_read_only.title: LAN connected — readings only
local_confirm_read_only.description: {name} responds at {host}. Readings are supported, but this DP layout or firmware does not yet have verified controls. Confirm to create the telemetry and diagnostics dashboard, without start/stop or the planner. Tuya Local is not required.

error.device_not_found: The selected Tuya charger was not found. Reload Home Assistant and try again.
error.prime_tuya_local_missing: Tuya Local was not found. Install it through HACS, restart HA and try again.
error.prime_profile_path_error: The Tuya Local directory uses a redirected path. Install the profile manually using the repository instructions.
error.prime_profile_conflict: The profile file already exists with different contents and was preserved. Compare it with the repository profile before updating it manually.
error.prime_profile_write_error: Could not write the profile. Check Tuya Local directory permissions and the Home Assistant log.
error.local_cannot_connect: No valid LAN response. Check IP, local key and protocol. Close any other local connection to the charger.
error.local_not_found: Device not discovered. Enter its IP address and retry.
error.local_invalid_credentials: Check device ID, 16-character local key and protocol.
error.local_invalid_host: Enter the charger private IPv4 address.
error.local_unsupported: The device responds but its DP layout is not supported yet.

abort.already_configured: This AmperePoint source is already configured.
abort.prime_profile_installed: The Prime profile is installed. Restart Home Assistant. Then add the charger in Tuya Local using its device ID, IP, local key and protocol 3.5; select the Wallbox PRIME profile matching the device data (older profile names may differ). If the charger has a wrong profile, preserve its connection details and add its Tuya Local entry again. In AmperePoint, choose automatic setup for the detected charger. Run this installer again if a Tuya Local update removes the profile.
abort.local_migrated: The existing charger has been migrated to AmperePoint Local. Open the dashboard.

settings.description: Update model, source entity mapping and tariff settings.

local_connection.title: AmperePoint Local connection
local_connection.description: Change IP, protocol or local key. Blank key keeps the existing key; blank IP runs discovery. The connection is tested before saving. Controls are available for the validated PRIME firmware layout, capped at 16 A and DP152. Home Assistant runs charging modes and the weekly planner over LAN; HA must stay running. Keep immediate charging selected in the device app.
